messages:
Rhea (Design): Quick heads-up from regression testing: when you resize table columns in the console, the split-action button on the right sometimes overflows the cell and becomes partially hidden. screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/ui/col-resize-overflow.png
Cole (Frontend): I can repro. The cell content uses `overflow: hidden` but the split-button uses negative margin for the caret; when the column gets narrow the caret sits outside the cell clipping box.
Samir (PM): Users want column resizing for power users but we can't allow controls to be inaccessible. What's the safest fix for next patch?
Lia (Dev): Two options: 1) make split-button always render inside an overflow-visible wrapper and clamp its minimum width, or 2) switch to an overflow menu (kebab) when column width < 160px. Option 2 is more defensive.
Rhea (Design): I prefer option 2 visually: switch to a compact kebab at very small widths so UI doesn't shift. But let's keep the visible affordance consistent and add tooltip text for the kebab: "More actions".
a11y-bot: Accessibility note: icon-only controls must have aria-label. If swapping UI based on size, ensure focus order doesn't jump and that keyboard users can still reach the actions. Provide a skip link or aria-controls if you change the DOM.
Cole (Frontend): Implementation plan: add a `@media (min-width:)`-like check or measure width in JS and swap to kebab when colWidth < 160. Also add `min-width: 160px` to `.action-cell` as a soft clamp. Patch:
```
if (colWidth < 160) showKebab(); else showSplit();
.action-cell{min-width:160px}
```
I'll include unit tests and storybook knobs.
Lia (Dev): Also found a stacking issue: when a modal is open while you resize columns, toasts anchored top-right sometimes appear behind the modal overlay because the toast z-index is lower. We should use the existing `toast.offsetTop` token and ensure toast z-index > modal overlay or constrain toasts to the modal stacking context. I vote for increasing toast z-index in theme to 950.
Rhea (Design): Prefer not to raise toast z-index globally. Could we check modal open -> push toasts below modal (so they don't distract) OR move toasts to `position: fixed` with a top offset token so they never get behind overlays?
Samir (PM): Keep this low-risk: use toast.offsetTop bump and ensure toasts are fixed; don't change z-index values that other teams rely on. Ship in next minor patch. No token renames; if needed add a `theme.compactToastOffset` alias.
Cole (Frontend): Agreed. I'll implement kebab fallback, soft min-width, and bump `toast.offsetTop` via theme alias when modal open or in compact layouts. Will include a11y checks: aria-labels, tabbable menu, focus restoration.
Rhea (Design): Copy choices: kebab tooltip "More actions"; split button primary label stays same. Add sr-only text for the kebab: "Row actions".
a11y-bot: PR checklist: no DOM reorder that breaks focus, icon-only controls have accessible names, responsive fallback documented, toast positioning token used instead of z-index hacks, keyboard menu tests.
Lia (Dev): Can someone pair on Percy snapshots after CI? want to confirm no regressions across narrow widths and modal interactions.
Samir (PM): I'll schedule a 20-minute review slot post-CI. Target release: 3.3.0-beta (non-breaking).
Rhea (Design): Thanks team  I'll add updated component spec and token alias notes to the design tokens doc.
